title: Debiasing: reducing bias introduced by the wording

videos.script: Every prompt says more than you meant it to. The order you list the labels in. A sentence about what most messages are. Which examples you happened to paste. {{wording}} None of those is an instruction, and a model can act on all of them. This lesson measures four of them, on the same seventy messages. {{runs}} Reversing the list of labels moves nineteen answers. Two of them go to labels that are not on the list at all, and twelve passes break. {{order}} One sentence saying most messages are about delivery moves thirty. Every one of them goes to delivery. {{leading}} Four billing examples out of five were supposed to pull answers to billing. On this model they did not, and the matrix is how you find that out. {{skewed}} Then you change only the customer's name. Two answers move, from returns to delivery. That proves the name reached the label, and nothing more. {{names}} By the end you can find a bias you wrote yourself. You change one thing, and you compare the answers. {{close}}
